FCommandCompletion.description: Closed operation-specific result union. Embed only when PendingCommand.status=succeeded. Unknown/rejected/pending/running commands must not carry fictitious completion. Reauthorize at each retrieval; secret-bearing URLs are short-lived and must never be cached or logged.

FSearchInsuranceCatalogRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Traverse only active category ancestors, apply effective availability before ranking, and return stable cursor pages ordered by score then identifier. Featured placement never makes an unavailable product purchasable.

FSearchInsuranceCatalogProjection.description: Business identity/state and applicable facts are required. Optional fields denote genuinely absent facts, never fabricated defaults. Property authorization precedes serialization.

FReadCarrierPlanProfileRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Return insurer identity, original profile content, plan revision and structured limits/exclusions. A summary links the versioned full wording and never asserts an uncontracted coverage.

FReadCarrierPlanProfileProjection.description: Business identity/state and applicable facts are required. Optional fields denote genuinely absent facts, never fabricated defaults. Property authorization precedes serialization.

FPublishProductAvailabilityRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: A catalog editor proposes and an independent catalog approver publishes a version. Self-service requires an approved form, carrier operation and commercial entitlement; otherwise expose explicitly assisted availability only.

FCreateApplicationDraftRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Pin a published form schema and validate the active conditional path server-side. A hidden field is removed from the submitted projection; a later form release cannot silently change an existing draft.

FSaveApplicationAnswersRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Save only schema-valid fields against the draft revision, preserve field errors without losing other answers, and record declaration acceptance separately from autosave. Resume rechecks ownership and quote eligibility.

FRequestApplicationAssistanceRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Compute evidence requirements from the pinned conditional rules, route an inaccessible or unsupported form to an assigned operator, and preserve stable field codes across translated labels.

FSavePersonAndDependentRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Store a person and relationship separately; dependent access requires verified guardian/delegate authority and records its effective dates. Revocation removes future reuse without rewriting policy snapshots.

FSaveInsuredAssetRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Validate attributes with the selected subject schema; normalize plate/device identifiers through an explicit country/type transform and retain supplied values separately where necessary for audit.

FReusePriorPolicyProfileRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Copy an authorized versioned projection into a new application after showing fields to be reused; source policy and consent references remain linked. Fresh risk declarations remain mandatory.

FRequestInsuranceHistoryRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Check subject authority and provider capability before sending only the approved owner/plate projection; persist request, purpose and provider mapping version before dispatch.

FReadInsuranceInquiryRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Return source, obtainedAt, validUntil, result confidence and exact no-claim record version. Apply a freshness requirement from the carrier contract when a quote uses the record.

FReadInsuranceInquiryProjection.description: Business identity/state and applicable facts are required. Optional fields denote genuinely absent facts, never fabricated defaults. Property authorization precedes serialization.

FCorrectInsuranceInquiryRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Keep the original response immutable, create a separately labeled correction proposal, and require an authorized reviewer before its use. Distinguish provider error from customer challenge.

FStartQuoteAggregationRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Evaluate carrier/product/channel eligibility once against the authoritative form snapshot, fan out within provider and tenant concurrency limits, and stream completed eligible results without waiting for the slowest carrier.

FReadQuoteResultsRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Deduplicate by carrier offer reference plus risk/plan revision, preserve original carrier values beside normalized comparison fields, and return explicit expiresAt and receivedAt for each offer.

FRefreshCarrierQuoteRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Send a fresh risk snapshot to the entitled carrier rating capability; record carrier rate-table or response version where supplied. Require buyer acceptance of a changed premium or coverage.

FCompareInsuranceOffersRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Compare only compatible risk/term/currency bases, label missing or incomparable fields, and show total payable and deductible units with approved wording references. Payment plan eligibility is evaluated per offer.

FCompareInsuranceOffersProjection.description: Business identity/state and applicable facts are required. Optional fields denote genuinely absent facts, never fabricated defaults. Property authorization precedes serialization.

FSortFilterOffersRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Apply stable price/coverage/service sorts with identifier tie-breaker and explicit data provenance for customer/service metrics. Filters operate on normalized values and retain counts for partial results.

FSortFilterOffersProjection.description: Business identity/state and applicable facts are required. Optional fields denote genuinely absent facts, never fabricated defaults. Property authorization precedes serialization.

FPublishComparisonBadgeRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Require evidence for objective badges, record sponsor identity and effective interval, visually label paid placement, and provide an unsponsored price sort. Ranking edits require review and audit.

FSelectBaseCoverageRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Validate selected limit and deductible against the carrier plan's enumerated allowed values and show exclusions from the same wording version. Never interpolate an unoffered amount.

FSelectCoverageRidersRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Resolve required base coverage and mutual exclusions before accepting riders; earthquake/war-related availability is contract-defined and defaults off. Persist why a rider is required or unavailable.

FPreviewCoveragePriceEffectRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Request or calculate prices only from an approved versioned carrier rule source, return a comparison to the prior offer, and invalidate prior acceptance when risks or totals change.

FSubmitRiskDeclarationRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Persist signed declaration text/version and evaluate deterministic eligibility rules with reasons. Unanswered required risk questions cannot default to a favorable answer.

FRequestUnderwritingEvidenceRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Assign an authorized reviewer, specify required documents and deadline, and give the applicant an upload/reply action. Evidence stays quarantined until scanned and reviewed.

FDecideUnderwritingRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Check reviewer authority, required evidence and rule version before recording an immutable decision. Conditional acceptance lists unresolved conditions; only fully satisfied acceptance permits issuance.

FBookVehicleInspectionRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Expose only contract-supported inspection modes, atomically reserve an available slot and record vehicle, provider, checklist version and cancellation cutoff.

FUploadInspectionEvidenceRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Associate each scanned photo/video with a required view and capture metadata; present completeness before submission and restrict evidence access to the case's authorized reviewers.

FDecideInspectionRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Record reviewer identity and per-item reasons, request specific retakes when needed, and pin carrier-defined evidence validity. Any material vehicle change invalidates earlier approval for a new application.

FSaveQuoteForResumeRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Save offer and application versions and retain the carrier expiry unchanged. Resume rechecks identity, current sales eligibility and quote validity before allowing selection.

FCreateScopedQuoteShareRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Generate a revocable high-entropy token stored only as a hash, limit its audience/actions and cap expiry at the quote's expiry. Mask risk fields not needed by the recipient.

FScheduleQuoteRecoveryRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Schedule a durable reminder only with the applicable preference and purpose, suppress after commitment/withdrawal/expiry, and link to authenticated resume rather than embedding personal answers.

FPublishProductRiskTemplateRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Require a family-specific insured subject schema, rating inputs and evidence rules for every PRD-01 through PRD-24. Publication includes channel and carrier capability bindings and a synthetic fixture.

FConfigureProductPlansRequest.description: Transport shape plus mandatory semantic guard: Distinguish standalone, rider, assisted and referral forms. Bind beneficiary relationship, declaration wording, inspection/underwriting and required documents to a carrier-approved version.
